question: Which supreme deities are directly present within the addressed deity?
premises: Śiva is directly situated in the deity
Indra, lord of the gods, is situated in the deity
Both presences are affirmed in the same locus
inference: The addressed deity embodies the direct presence of Śiva and Indra
plain_english: In you Śiva is directly present; in you is Śakra, the lord of the gods.
